content: Nasareti ari yokamai Yesu mounom wako teime
Ena yesu akai tei ma dere fu mam iki tei fungoro gama yokamai mouwomdi fime.

Fu moingoro Yura ari iron kakom Yesu fu ka nuwi si ereinga ikom fure koro mapunom boiro ka kirawa si erongoro ena ari yokamai munmane ka i fire inokore munmane eire epe dime, “Yaromi ka dungua amai fire ire ure di erome? Te eramom mapunom kirawa si tongoro yaromi tawa ure tai ta ta ori bemie?

Yaromi iki keinga kokonan ingua yaromi moime. Yaromi nenen mam i Maria te emeroma yokamai Yemesi te Yosisi te Yurasi te Saimon moime. Te yaromi kepoma no gere ama moipune,” epe dire te denom minom niki de fi tere moingoro

ena Yesu ka epe di erome, “Ari yokamai man bunam koro koro moingi Yai Gumam ka mapunom yai kam akire di iwa de teimba nen ariyoma te moiyom yokoiyom yokamai kam akire di iwa de tekeime,” epe di erome.
Te yaromi akai tei moingui tai ta ta ori beikenaro bemba yaromi ari towane towane nupi fainga yokamai okom ganom akoro i koi de erome.

Te ari yokamai nomanenom fi ki sikeinga Yesu inokore munmane eme. Yesu gama okonom koro koro muruwo te kaunom surai ewi man man dome Mt 10:5-15; Lk 9:1-6 Ena Yesu fu iki birom ori dungui dungui tei fure ari ka nuwi si erome.
Ena Yesu gama okonom koro koro muruwo te kaunom surai unom boingoro wingoro murom niki deinga ewi mena dowangua yoporam boi erere
te “Ne yokamai guwai gainom tai ta ta ire kiyo! Ne yokamai kua te gai kapan te kongo mukom ire kiyo! Te goropo towane ire fiyo!
Ne yokamai kaunom tou deimba gai suna towane wom fire waniyo!
Te ne yokamai iki birom ori ta ikai fure fu ikom towane moraingi tei kopuna nere moire faire ena okome ‘Akai ta napune,’ di fire iki i ma dere naime.

Te ne yokamai iki birom ori ta finga ari iki kapakom yokamai ne yokamai fana gai erekere te ne yokamai kanom duwainga fikenainga iran ne yokamai naro beinga kakom kuwan kaunom duwangui tei towa towa kei deiyo! Towa towa kei dowainga ena ari yokamai muruwo mapunom niki dongua beinga firaime,” epe di erere ipu sire yai surai surai ewi man man dome.
Ena Yesu gama yokama fu man man fure “Ne yokamai nomanenom si awa teiyo!” di mari dere
te murom niki deinga yokamai munmane ewi mena dere te ari nupi fainga yokamai ganom eri nurom bui erero i koi de ereime.
Yokama Yoane nuwi bui erongua yaromi si goime
Ena kakom tei Yesu kam wayom koro koro fungua iran Eroti Yesu tai bengua fime. Ari suwo koropane “Yoane nuwi bui erongua yaromi goingua arongua ena tai ta ta ori bei moime,” epe dimba
ari suwo “Yaromi Yai Gumam ka mapunom yai Iraiya moime,” epe dimba ari suwo koropane “Komariwom Yai Gumam ka mapunom ari moingamere yaromi epena ama epe moime,” epe dime.
Epe ka dingero ena yai ori Eroti ka i fingua “Tamanume. Yoane na birom si guwo dikai yaromi tokoi ariro moime,” epe dume.

Tora bengoro Eroti ka epe dume? Mapunom i epe: Komari Eroti emerom Firipi efem biyai i kam Erotiasi ingero ena Yoane yaromi “Ne emerom yokori moingui ne yaromi efem biyai inga faikeme,” di tongoro ena Eroti kiminem ka di erongua yokamai fu Yoane okom a ki sire kan ikom de teime.
De teimba Yoane “Ne emerom efem biyai inga faikemie,” di moingua iran Erotiasi oparomi Yoane fi niki de tere “Wiom biyai suwame,” dire bai taki sire moimba Eroti “E e” dume.
Yoane i yai nokapu moingua te yaromi yo tongua moingua iran Eroti Yoane kuri fi tere kiapam nokapu bei tome. Eroti Yoane ka dungua mun fimba yaromi inokore unanan eme.
Ena okome oparomi Yoane suwangua kakom epe fuka dume. Eroti kui engua kakom kua kopuna keire ari kiapanom yokama te kiminem ari ori beinga yokamai te Gariri akai ari mokoinga yokamai erome.

Ena yokamai kuku boi moingoro Erotiasi apom ure mapunom i nowi ingoro Eroti te ari koi moinga yokamai kanere mun kanime. Ena yai ori Eroti ama biange ka epe di tome, “Ne tai ta ta kuianum boi erowangua erowaiye.
Te na okonam koi mapunamdi dere kawom duwaiye. Ne ‘Tai inaiye,’ duwanga erowaiye. Te ne ‘Na manam sinom inaiye,’ duwanga koro giwi eiro erowaiye,” epe di tongoro
ena ama dere mena fure mam moingui tei furo “Na tora inaika ka di towaiye,” diro mina wako tongoro mam “Ne ‘Yoane nuwi bui erongua yaromi birom inaiye,’ di to!” di tongoro
ena ama kene kene eire bu dire fu yai ori moingui tei fure “Ne Yoane nuwi bui erongua yaromi birom borere kopare tei eire ire kene kene eire naro!” epe di tongoro
ena yai ori dem miriyom ipun ori domba yaromi ka di koi engua te ari yokamai ama kua ne moinga iran “Ka di teika si dekenaiye,” di firo
kiminem yai ta “Ne fure Yoane birom ire uwo!” di tere kene kene eire awi dongoro ena kiminem fu kan iki furo birom borere
kopare tei eire ire inako dero ure ama biange tongoro ama ire mam tome.
Ena Yoane gama yokamai ka wayom i fire ure yono ire man si teime.
Yesu ari yokamai munmane wom kua kopuna erome
Ena Yesu ewi dongua finga yokamai u Yesu moingui tei ure wanapo de suna dere taikan muruwo beinga te ka nuwi si ereinga muruwo di teime.

Ena yokamai munmane ure fure bei moingoro Yesu te gama yokamai kua kopuna nowainga kakom dikengua iran Yesu “Ne yokamai na gere fu ari moikeinga akaiyom fure kakom suwo iron moi firapune,” di erongoro
ena yokamai nenen nuwi kopare ikai fure ari moikeinga akaiyom fime.
Fimba ari yokamai munmane kanero giranom gumanom kanere fire ena iki birom ori dungui dungui tei ma dere mangi bu dire fure koma akai i fuka dime.

Ena okome Yesu ure nuwi kopare ma dere kanungua ari munmane moiro non sipsip kiapanom bengua yaromi moikengoro non unanan fingamere yokamai epe moinga iran Yesu yokamai kanom fi erere ka mapunom mapunom nuwi si erome.
Ka nuwi si erongui kamun taroma engoro ena Yesu gama u moingui tei ure “Yae, akai tawa i ari kei faingi tei moikeingoro te epena kamun taroma engua
ena iran ari yokamai fu iki birom ori dungui dungui bo akai bunam koro koro furo kua kopuna meina bairo nowaro beinga ewi do!” di teimba
Yesu “Ne yokamai tai nowainga ereiyo!” di erongoro “No furo kapa okonom koro muruwo koro suraiye kokonan beire meina ire kua kopuna meina bairo ire uro erowapunga kam dino?” di teingoro
ena Yesu “Ne yokamai kaime dori tora mina duwangua furo kaniyo!” di erongoro yokamai furo kanere inako dero “Kaime dori okonom koro muruwo dunguai te nuwi kapu surai ama dume,” di teime.
Ena Yesu gama yokamai “Ne yokamai ari muruwo ‘Kui nokapu dungui tei kapo kapo kuku boire ame dere moiyo!’ di ereiyo!” di erongoro gama yokamai furo ari epe di ereingoro
ena yokamai 100 kuku boi ta moingoro te 50 kuku boi ta moingoro epe ame dere moingoro

Yesu kaime dori okonom koro muruwo te nuwi kapu surai ire kan kamundi teme iwa dere “Mun fiye,” dire kaime dori dou dire gama yokamai erere “Ari muruwo ereiyo!” di erome. Te yaromi nuwi kapu surai ipu sire ama ari muruwo erongoro
ena ari yokamai muruwo nere maranom mokongoro
Yesu gama yokamai kaime dori te nuwi kapu onam koro yo di fungua ire gai kouma gai okonom koro koro muruwo te kaunom surai gi murome.
Te kopuna neinga yai gan i munmanewom epemere 5000 moime.
Yesu nuwi boromdi wan fume
Ena ari yokamai kua kopuna mora ne gouingoro Yesu kene kene eire gama yokamai “Ne yokamai nuwi kopare ikai furo koro ipo Besaira akai koma fiyo! Na ari yokamai ewi dowaika unaiye,” di erere
ena yokamai moingi tei ma dere kopu tei mokore Yai Gumam ka make ei towaro fume.
Ena kamun kama sungoro nuwi kopare i fu nuwi dian ori suna tei fungoro te Yesu nenen nuwi bunamdi tei moiro

kanungua kamun kai ori ure nuwi kopare gumam sungoro ena gama yokamai buro arari okonomdi nuwi singa burom nuwi suwainga faikeme. Ena iran kamun takonangua kakom tei Yesu nuwi boromdi wan fure yokamai moingi tei fume. Yaromi “Ema dere naiye,” di bemba
gama yokamai kaningai Yesu nuwi dian boromdi wan ungoro “I giri yaromi ume,” di fire
au dire kuri ori wom fingero ena yaromi kene kene eire “Ne yokamai denom minom yoporam boiyo! Na nanan uka iran kuri fikeiyo!” di erere
ena yokamai nuwi kopare ikai moingi tei moko fungoro kamun kai wira dire sume.
Te gama yokamai nomanenom fere de ki singoro ena Yesu kaime dori dou dire ari erongua mapunom fikeinga iran inokore munmane wom eime.
Yesu Genesareti akai furo ari nupi fainga yokamai i koi de erome
Ena Yesu te gama yokamai fu nuwi dian bunam koro fure Genesareti akai fuka dire nuwi kopare kan koi eime.
Ena yokama nuwi kopare ma dere ako mangi winga kakom ari kapakom yokamai Yesu giram gumam fire kanere
ena bu di fu man man fure ari nupi fainga yokamai kuki boromdi eire endire “Yesu moimie,” dinga firo tei fime.

Te yaromi iki birom ori nambo akai ori gawo tei nambo bunam koro koro nambo ari yokamai nupi fainga yokamai endire maket akaiyom tei eime. Ena nupi fainga yokama Yesu yana epe di teime, “No ne ganum bo ne gainum akonaro bepune,” di tere ena ari muruwo yaromi akoinga u nokapu fime.
